phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Core setup, types, database, basic UI

features.title: Monorepo scaffold with Turborepo
features.description: Initialize monorepo structure with Turborepo for build orchestration. Setup apps/web, apps/server, apps/desktop, packages/types, packages/db directories with proper tsconfig paths.
acceptanceCriteria: turbo.json configured with build, dev, check pipelines
Package workspaces defined in root package.json
bun run dev starts all apps concurrently

features.title: Shared types package with branded types
features.description: Create packages/types with branded types for FeatureId, ProjectId, SessionId using Zod. Export type inference utilities and shared constants.
acceptanceCriteria: Branded types prevent mixing IDs at compile time

features.title: Feature Zod schema with validation
features.description: Define Feature Zod schema matching feature.schema.json. Include all fields: id, title, category, description, status, passes, acceptanceCriteria, dependencies.

features.title: Project Zod schema with validation
features.description: Define Project Zod schema for multi-project support. Include name, path, settings, createdAt, updatedAt fields with proper validation.

features.title: Session Zod schema for agent sessions
features.description: Define Session Zod schema for tracking agent execution sessions. Include sessionId, featureId, status, startedAt, completedAt, output fields.

features.title: Database package with Drizzle ORM
features.description: Setup packages/db with Drizzle ORM and SQLite (libSQL). Configure drizzle.config.ts, create initial schema file, setup migration system.

features.title: Projects table schema
features.description: Create Drizzle schema for projects table with id, name, path, settings (JSON), createdAt, updatedAt columns. Add indexes for name lookup.

features.title: Features table schema
features.description: Create Drizzle schema for features table mirroring feature.schema.json. Include all fields with proper SQLite types, foreign key to projects.
acceptanceCriteria: All feature fields mapped to columns

features.title: Sessions table schema
features.description: Create Drizzle schema for sessions table tracking agent executions. Include foreign keys to features and projects, output storage.

features.title: Learning table schema
features.description: Create Drizzle schema for learnings table storing patterns extracted from feature implementations. Include category, pattern, antiPattern, context fields.

features.title: Database migrations initial setup
features.description: Generate and run initial migrations for all tables. Setup migration runner in server startup, handle schema versioning.

features.title: Repository pattern for projects
features.description: Implement ProjectRepository with CRUD operations using Drizzle. Include findAll, findById, create, update, delete methods with proper typing.

features.title: Repository pattern for features
features.description: Implement FeatureRepository with CRUD and query operations. Include findByProject, findByStatus, updateStatus, bulk operations.

features.title: Repository pattern for sessions
features.description: Implement SessionRepository for agent session tracking. Include create, update, findByFeature, findActive methods.

features.title: Hono server setup with oRPC
features.description: Setup apps/server with Hono framework and oRPC for type-safe APIs. Configure middleware stack, CORS, error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Hono server starts on configured port

features.title: Health check endpoint
features.description: Implement /health endpoint returning server status, database connection, and version info. Used by Tauri to verify backend is running.

features.title: Projects oRPC router
features.description: Implement oRPC router for project CRUD operations. Include list, get, create, update, delete procedures with Zod validation.

features.title: Features oRPC router
features.description: Implement oRPC router for feature operations. Include list, get, create, update, delete, updateStatus, bulkUpdate procedures.

features.title: Sessions oRPC router
features.description: Implement oRPC router for session operations. Include create, get, list, updateStatus procedures for agent session tracking.

features.title: React app with TanStack Router
features.description: Setup apps/web with React 19, Vite 6, TanStack Router. Configure routes for dashboard, project, feature detail pages.

features.title: Tailwind CSS 4 setup with shadcn/ui
features.description: Configure Tailwind CSS 4 with shadcn/ui component library. Setup theme tokens, dark mode support, component directory structure.

features.title: Zustand store for global state
features.description: Setup Zustand store for application state. Create slices for projects, features, sessions, UI state with proper typing.

features.title: TanStack Query setup for API calls
features.description: Configure TanStack Query with oRPC client. Setup query keys, default options, error handling, optimistic updates.

features.title: App layout with sidebar navigation
features.description: Create main app layout with collapsible sidebar, header, and content area. Include project selector, navigation links, user menu.

features.title: Kanban board component
features.description: Create Kanban board with columns for each status (backlog, in_progress, waiting_approval, verified). Use dnd-kit for drag-drop.

features.title: Feature card component
features.description: Create feature card showing id, title, priority badge, size indicator, dependency count. Compact view for Kanban column.

features.title: Feature detail panel
features.description: Create slide-out panel for feature details. Show all fields, acceptance criteria checklist, dependencies graph, action buttons.

features.title: Feature create/edit form
features.description: Create form for adding/editing features using TanStack Form. Validate with Zod schema, handle acceptance criteria array.

features.title: Kanban column header with count
features.description: Create column header showing status name, feature count, optional actions menu. Include collapse/expand toggle.

features.title: Kanban filters and search
features.description: Add filter bar above Kanban with search, category filter, phase filter, priority filter. Persist filter state.

features.title: Claude Agent SDK client setup
features.description: Setup @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk in server. Configure API client, model selection, tool permissions, environment variables.

features.title: Agent session creation service
features.description: Implement AgentService.createSession() to initialize Claude agent with feature context, system prompt, and tool configuration.

features.title: Agent execution with streaming
features.description: Implement agent execution with streaming output. Capture text, tool calls, tool results, and thinking tokens in real-time.

features.title: WebSocket server for real-time events
features.description: Setup WebSocket server in Hono for real-time event streaming. Handle connections, authentication, message routing.

features.title: Agent output WebSocket streaming
features.description: Stream agent output to connected clients via WebSocket. Emit events for text chunks, tool calls, completion, errors.

features.title: Agent output viewer component
features.description: Create React component to display streaming agent output. Show markdown formatted text, collapsible tool calls, thinking indicator.

features.title: Tool call visualization
features.description: Create component to display tool calls with name, input, output, duration. Color-code by tool type, show file diffs.

features.title: Extended thinking display
features.description: Show extended thinking tokens in collapsible section. Display token count, thinking time, summary extraction.

features.title: Start feature execution button
features.description: Add button to feature detail to start agent execution. Show confirmation dialog with options for model, thinking level, planning mode.

features.title: Stop feature execution
features.description: Add ability to stop running agent execution. Send cancel signal, cleanup resources, update session status.

features.title: Git worktree creation service
features.description: Implement GitService.createWorktree() to create isolated worktree for feature. Handle branch naming, path creation, cleanup.

features.title: Git worktree deletion service
features.description: Implement GitService.deleteWorktree() to cleanup after feature merge. Remove worktree directory, prune branches.

features.title: Git commit service
features.description: Implement GitService.commit() with conventional commit format. Include feature ID, title, acceptance criteria summary.

features.title: Git merge service
features.description: Implement GitService.merge() to merge feature branch to main. Use --no-ff strategy, handle conflicts, update feature status.

features.title: Git diff viewer component
features.description: Create component to display git diffs with syntax highlighting. Show file changes, additions, deletions, line numbers.

features.title: Git status display
features.description: Create component showing worktree git status. Display staged, unstaged, untracked files with actions.

features.title: Quality gate: TypeScript check
features.description: Implement quality gate that runs tsc --noEmit in worktree. Capture errors, parse output, report pass/fail.

features.title: Quality gate: Lint check
features.description: Implement quality gate that runs biome check in worktree. Capture lint errors, format issues, report results.

features.title: Quality gate: Test runner
features.description: Implement quality gate that runs vitest in worktree. Capture test results, coverage, failures with stack traces.

features.title: Quality gate: Build check
features.description: Implement quality gate that runs production build. Verify build succeeds, check bundle size, report warnings.

features.title: Quality gates pipeline runner
features.description: Orchestrate quality gates in sequence: TypeScript, Lint, Test, Build. Stop on first failure, aggregate results.

features.title: Quality gates results display
features.description: Create component showing quality gate results with pass/fail status, duration, error details for each gate.

features.title: Auto-mode toggle and status
features.description: Add auto-mode toggle to header. Show running/paused status, current feature, queue count indicator.

features.title: Auto-mode execution loop
features.description: Implement core auto-mode loop: pick next feature, execute agent, run pipeline, update status, repeat.

features.title: Feature queue management
features.description: Implement feature queue for auto-mode. Sort by priority, respect dependencies, allow manual reordering.

features.title: Auto-mode failure detection
features.description: Track consecutive failures in auto-mode. Pause after 3 failures, emit alert, require manual intervention.

features.title: Auto-mode resume after pause
features.description: Allow resuming auto-mode after pause. Show failure summary, allow skipping failed feature or retrying.

features.title: Auto-mode concurrency limit
features.description: Configure maximum concurrent feature executions. Default to 1, allow configuration up to 3 for parallel agents.

features.title: Auto-mode queue visualization
features.description: Create queue panel showing upcoming features, current execution, completed in session. Allow drag reorder.

features.title: Session persistence and recovery
features.description: Persist auto-mode state to database. Recover queue and progress after server restart or crash.

features.title: Better-auth integration setup
features.description: Setup better-auth for session authentication. Configure providers, session storage, cookie settings.

features.title: Login page component
features.description: Create login page with email/password form. Handle errors, loading state, redirect after success.

features.title: Protected route middleware
features.description: Implement route protection in TanStack Router. Redirect unauthenticated users to login, preserve return URL.

features.title: API authentication middleware
features.description: Implement Hono middleware to validate session on API requests. Return 401 for unauthenticated requests.

features.title: Worktree path sandboxing
features.description: Validate all file operations stay within worktree boundaries. Block path traversal attempts, log violations.

features.title: API key secure storage
features.description: Store Anthropic API key securely. Use system keychain on desktop, encrypted storage on web.

features.title: Input validation middleware
features.description: Validate all API inputs with Zod schemas. Reject malformed requests, sanitize strings, limit sizes.

features.title: Security headers middleware
features.description: Add security headers to all responses: CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, etc.

features.title: Settings service and storage
features.description: Implement SettingsService for persisting user preferences. Store in database, provide defaults, validate values.

features.title: Settings page UI
features.description: Create settings page with sections for general, AI, git, appearance preferences. Save on change.

features.title: Model selection setting
features.description: Allow selecting default Claude model: opus, sonnet, haiku. Store preference, apply to new sessions.

features.title: Thinking level setting
features.description: Configure default thinking budget level: none, standard, extended, ultrathink. Show token estimates.

features.title: Planning mode setting
features.description: Configure default planning mode: skip, lite, spec, full. Explain differences in UI.

features.title: Auto-mode settings panel
features.description: Configure auto-mode behavior: concurrency, failure threshold, pause conditions, queue behavior.

features.title: Toast notification system
features.description: Implement toast notifications for user feedback. Support info, success, warning, error types with auto-dismiss.

features.title: Feature status change notifications
features.description: Show toast when feature status changes. Include feature ID, title, new status, link to detail.

features.title: Auto-mode event notifications
features.description: Show notifications for auto-mode events: started, paused, feature completed, failure detected.

features.title: Event history log
features.description: Store and display event history. Show recent events in sidebar, allow filtering by type.

features.title: Learning extraction service
features.description: Implement service to extract patterns from completed features. Analyze success/failure, identify reusable patterns.

features.title: Learning injection in prompts
features.description: Inject relevant learnings into agent prompts. Match patterns by category, feature type, similar context.

features.title: CLAUDE.md context loading
features.description: Load project CLAUDE.md and inject into agent context. Parse sections, respect hierarchy, merge with global.

features.title: Learnings browser UI
features.description: Create UI to browse and manage extracted learnings. Filter by category, search, edit, delete.

features.title: Feature dependency graph
features.description: Visualize feature dependencies as directed graph. Show blocking/blocked relationships, highlight cycles.

features.title: Dependency resolution for queue
features.description: Ensure features with unverified dependencies don't start. Check recursively, report blockers.

features.title: Circular dependency detection
features.description: Detect and prevent circular dependencies when editing features. Show error with cycle path.

features.title: Tauri app setup
features.description: Initialize Tauri app wrapping web frontend. Configure window, icons, build settings for macOS/Linux.

features.title: Backend spawn from Tauri
features.description: Spawn backend server as sidecar process from Tauri. Handle startup, shutdown, health checks.

features.title: System tray integration
features.description: Add system tray icon with context menu. Show auto-mode status, quick actions, quit option.

features.title: Native notifications
features.description: Send native OS notifications for important events. Feature completed, auto-mode paused, errors.

features.title: File system access permissions
features.description: Configure Tauri file system permissions. Allow access to project directories, restrict system files.

features.title: Terminal PTY service
features.description: Implement PTY management service using node-pty. Create sessions, handle input/output, manage lifecycle.

features.title: Terminal WebSocket endpoint
features.description: Create WebSocket endpoint for terminal I/O. Handle connections, message routing, session binding.

features.title: xterm.js terminal component
features.description: Create terminal component using xterm.js. Connect to WebSocket, handle input, render output.

features.title: Terminal split panes
features.description: Allow splitting terminal into multiple panes. Horizontal and vertical splits, drag resize.

features.title: Terminal session per worktree
features.description: Open terminal sessions in feature worktree directory. Auto-cd on session start.

features.title: Dark/light theme toggle
features.description: Implement theme toggle between dark and light modes. Persist preference, respect system setting.

features.title: Theme color customization
features.description: Allow customizing accent colors. Provide presets, allow custom hex input, preview changes.

features.title: Font family setting
features.description: Allow selecting UI font family. Provide system fonts, popular coding fonts, custom input.

features.title: Font size adjustment
features.description: Allow adjusting base font size. Slider or input, live preview, persist setting.

features.title: Layout persistence
features.description: Persist UI layout state: sidebar width, panel positions, collapsed sections. Restore on load.

features.title: Keyboard shortcuts system
features.description: Implement global keyboard shortcuts for common actions. Use hotkeys library, allow customization.

features.title: Command palette
features.description: Implement command palette (Cmd+K) for quick actions. Search commands, recent actions, navigate.

features.title: Quick feature search
features.description: Add global feature search with Cmd+P. Search by ID, title, category. Navigate to result.

features.title: Breadcrumb navigation
features.description: Add breadcrumbs showing current location. Project > Phase > Feature with clickable links.

features.title: Recent features list
features.description: Track recently viewed features. Show in sidebar, persist across sessions, limit to 10.

features.title: Pino logging setup
features.description: Configure Pino logger for backend. Structured JSON logs, log levels, request logging middleware.

features.title: Agent session logging
features.description: Log agent sessions with structured data. Include tokens used, duration, tool calls, outcome.

features.title: Debug mode toggle
features.description: Add debug mode toggle showing verbose information. Extra logging, raw API responses, timing.

features.title: Session metrics dashboard
features.description: Create dashboard showing agent session metrics. Total runs, success rate, average duration, tokens.

features.title: Token usage tracking
features.description: Track and display token usage per session, feature, project. Show costs if API pricing known.

features.title: GitHub PR creation
features.description: Create GitHub PR from merged feature. Include feature title, description, acceptance criteria.

features.title: GitHub PR template
features.description: Generate PR description from template. Include summary, test plan, acceptance checklist.

features.title: GitHub issue linking
features.description: Link features to GitHub issues. Auto-close issue on merge, sync status bidirectionally.

features.title: GitHub Actions status
features.description: Display GitHub Actions workflow status for feature branches. Show pending, success, failure.

features.title: Feature specification editor
features.description: Create rich editor for feature specifications. Markdown support, template insertion, preview.

features.title: Acceptance criteria templates
features.description: Provide templates for acceptance criteria. GIVEN-WHEN-THEN format, common patterns.

features.title: AI-enhanced description
features.description: Use AI to enhance feature descriptions. Suggest improvements, add technical details, expand scope.

features.title: Planning document generation
features.description: Generate implementation plan document from feature spec. Include tasks, file changes, testing.

features.title: Plan approval workflow
features.description: Require human approval for generated plans. Show diff from previous, approve/reject buttons.

features.title: Unit test template generation
features.description: Generate unit test file templates from feature spec. Include test cases from acceptance criteria.

features.title: Test coverage report display
features.description: Display test coverage reports in UI. Show percentages, highlight uncovered lines, trend over time.

features.title: Vitest configuration
features.description: Configure Vitest for monorepo. Setup workspaces, coverage, reporters, watch mode.

features.title: Playwright E2E setup
features.description: Configure Playwright for E2E testing. Setup config, example test, CI integration.

features.title: Biome configuration
features.description: Configure Biome for linting and formatting. Setup rules, ignore patterns, editor integration.

features.title: Husky pre-commit hooks
features.description: Setup Husky for git hooks. Pre-commit runs lint-staged, commit-msg validates format.

features.title: Bulk feature import
features.description: Import features from JSON or CSV file. Validate against schema, merge or replace options.

features.title: Feature export
features.description: Export features to JSON or CSV. Filter by status, phase, category before export.

features.title: Feature duplication
features.description: Duplicate existing feature with new ID. Copy all fields, reset status to backlog.

features.title: Bulk status update
features.description: Select multiple features and update status. Show confirmation with count, validate transitions.

features.title: Feature archival
features.description: Archive completed or cancelled features. Hide from main view, accessible in archive section.

features.title: Agent tool: Read file
features.description: Implement Read tool for agent to read files in worktree. Validate path, return content.

features.title: Agent tool: Write file
features.description: Implement Write tool for agent to create/overwrite files. Validate path, create directories.

features.title: Agent tool: Edit file
features.description: Implement Edit tool for precise string replacements. Match exact strings, report if not found.

features.title: Agent tool: Bash command
features.description: Implement Bash tool for running commands. Sandbox to worktree, timeout, capture output.

features.title: Agent tool: Glob search
features.description: Implement Glob tool for file pattern matching. Search in worktree, return matching paths.

features.title: Agent tool: Grep search
features.description: Implement Grep tool for content search. Regex support, context lines, file filtering.

features.title: Agent system prompt builder
features.description: Build system prompt from feature spec, project context, learnings. Assemble sections in order.

features.title: Agent retry on failure
features.description: Implement retry logic for agent failures. Exponential backoff, max retries, error classification.

features.title: Agent checkpoint system
features.description: Save checkpoints during agent execution. Allow resume from checkpoint after failure.

features.title: MCP server integration
features.description: Support MCP servers for external tools. Load from config, expose to agent, handle responses.

features.title: Project creation wizard
features.description: Create guided wizard for new projects. Select directory, configure settings, import features.

features.title: Project switching
features.description: Allow switching between projects. Update context, refresh features, maintain state.

features.title: Project settings page
features.description: Create project-specific settings page. Override global defaults, configure paths.

features.title: Project statistics dashboard
features.description: Show project statistics: feature count by status, completion rate, recent activity.

features.title: Git branch management UI
features.description: Display and manage git branches for project. Show feature branches, allow delete, switch.

features.title: Commit history viewer
features.description: Display commit history for feature branch. Show messages, authors, dates, diffs.

features.title: Merge conflict resolution UI
features.description: Display merge conflicts with side-by-side view. Allow manual resolution, accept ours/theirs.

features.title: Stash management
features.description: Manage git stashes from UI. Create, apply, drop stashes for worktrees.

features.title: Worktree status display
features.description: Show worktree status in feature card. Indicate active, stale, or missing worktree.

features.title: Auto-cleanup stale worktrees
features.description: Automatically cleanup worktrees for verified features after configurable period.

features.title: Terminal scrollback buffer
features.description: Configure terminal scrollback buffer size. Limit memory usage, allow search in history.

features.title: Terminal session tabs

features.title: Terminal font settings

features.title: Terminal color schemes

features.title: Terminal copy/paste
features.description: Enable copy/paste in terminal. Selection highlighting, right-click menu, keyboard shortcuts.

features.title: Phase progress visualization

features.title: Category grouping view

features.title: Table view for features

features.title: Feature priority badges
features.description: Display priority with colored badges. Critical=red, high=orange, medium=yellow, low=gray.

features.title: Feature size indicators
features.description: Show estimated size on cards. XS/S/M/L/XL with visual indicator, filter by size.

features.title: Feature tags system

features.title: Acceptance criteria checklist
features.description: Display AC as interactive checklist. Check off items, show progress, persist state.

features.title: Feature activity timeline

features.title: Feature comments/notes

features.title: Real-time Kanban updates

features.title: Session output persistence

features.title: Session replay viewer
features.description: Replay historical sessions with timeline. Step through tool calls, see output progression.

features.title: Follow-up instructions input
features.description: Allow adding follow-up instructions after agent pauses. Continue session with new context.

features.title: Model selection per feature
features.description: Override default model for specific features. Show recommendation based on complexity.

features.title: Thinking level per feature
features.description: Override thinking level for specific features. Show recommendation based on complexity.

features.title: Agent execution statistics

features.title: Database backup service

features.title: Data export/import

features.title: Loading skeleton components

features.title: Confirmation dialogs
